Core Components

This section documents the core components of the 5e2pdf system.

Data Models

The core data models represent D&D content types and provide validation.

Base content models for all D&D content types.

class src.core.models.content.ContentType(value)[source]

Bases: str, Enum

Enumeration of supported D&D content types.

ADVENTURE = 'adventure'
BOOK = 'book'
SPELL = 'spell'
CREATURE = 'creature'
ITEM = 'item'
CLASS = 'class'
BACKGROUND = 'background'
FEAT = 'feat'
RACE = 'race'
SUPPLEMENT = 'supplement'
classmethod from_content(content: BaseContent) → ContentType[source]

Determine content type from content object.

Parameters:

content – Content object to analyze

Returns:

ContentType corresponding to the content

Raises:

ValueError – If content type cannot be determined
